data.one_liner: Flutter port of shadcn/ui providing customizable UI components
data.what_it_does: Offers a collection of shadcn-style widgets such as buttons, dialogs, forms, and layout helpers. Components are fully customizable via theming and props. It supports multiple platforms including web, mobile, and desktop.
use_when: You need a cohesive design system with shadcn-style components
You want to avoid writing custom widgets for common UI patterns
You need cross-platform support with consistent look and feel
avoid_when: You already use another design system like Material or Cupertino
You require highly specialized widgets not covered by the library
You need extensive native integrations beyond UI
strengths: Active maintenance and recent feature additions
weaknesses: Documentation may be incomplete for advanced use
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec.yaml, import package, no build_runner needed

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides Material Design components with extensive ecosystem

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers Cupertino widgets for iOS look and feel
